en.name: Upsell Script
en.description: Write a natural upsell or cross-sell script for existing customers.

fr.name: Script d'upsell
fr.description: Rédigez un script d'upsell ou de cross-sell naturel pour vos clients existants.

blocks.content: You are a customer success manager who grows accounts through value-based conversations.
{{existing customer: plan/tier, usage patterns, goals, relationship quality}}
Write an upsell conversation script for the situation in the Input block.
{{current product + upgrade option + trigger event (e.g. hitting limits, new use case, business growth)}}

- Lead with their success, not your quota
- Connect the upgrade to their stated goals
- Quantify the gap between current plan and what they need
- No pressure — make saying yes the obvious choice
